comments.zh: 声明冲突与块内禁区（NCMAP_F29~F32）触发样例（Error 级——真实声明会阻断编译，
comments.en: Declaration Conflict and In-Block Forbidden Zones (NCMAP_F29–F32) Examples (Error-level—actual declarations halt compilation,

comments.zh: 以注释形态呈现，对齐 how-to/fluent/from-source.md「声明冲突与块内禁区」节）：</para>
comments.en: presented as comments, aligned with the 'Declaration Conflict and In-Block Forbidden Zones' section in how-to/fluent/from-source.md):</para>

comments.zh: // NCMAP_F29（同 dest 冲突）：主链 Map 与 FromSource 绑定指向同一属性
comments.en: // NCMAP_F29 (conflict with dest): Main-chain Map and FromSource bindings target the same property

comments.zh: .Member(d => d.OrderNo).From(s => s.OrderNo)          // 主链声明
comments.en: .Member(d => d.OrderNo).From(s => s.OrderNo)          // Main-chain declaration

comments.zh: .Member(d => d.OrderNo).FromSource<FsCustomerSub>(s => s.Name);  // Error：一个属性只能由一个源供给
comments.en: .Member(d => d.OrderNo).FromSource<FsCustomerSub>(s => s.Name);  // Error: A property can be supplied by only one source

comments.zh: // NCMAP_F30（块内禁止 ConvertBack）：FromSource 绑定仅正向映射，无反向写回落点
comments.en: // NCMAP_F30 (ConvertBack forbidden within block): FromSource bindings support forward mapping only; no reverse write-back endpoint exists

comments.zh: c.Member(d => d.CustomerName).ConvertBack(Conv);  // Error：块内禁止
comments.en: c.Member(d => d.CustomerName).ConvertBack(Conv);  // Error: Forbidden within block

comments.zh: // NCMAP_F31（块内禁止 NoAutoInclude）：子源字段全显式声明，无自动包含可禁
comments.en: // NCMAP_F31 (NoAutoInclude forbidden within block): All sub-source fields are explicitly declared; no automatic inclusion to disable

comments.zh: // NCMAP_F32（块内禁止 AfterMapping）：生成的 Compose 管线无钩子注入口，声明永不执行
comments.en: // NCMAP_F32 (AfterMapping forbidden within block): The generated Compose pipeline has no hook injection point; such declarations never execute

comments.en: Chained declaration entry point.
